decisions.title: Bcrypt via passlib[bcrypt] (work factor 12), ratifying the story/research decision
decisions.rationale: The story's Decision log already chose passlib[bcrypt] over argon2/scrypt and fixed the work factor at 12, and research scored this GO-WITH-CONDITIONS with a latency-benchmark condition to confirm the budget holds at that work factor. This mini-ADR ratifies that decision at the implementation-planning level: AuthService.hash_password and verify_credentials use CryptContext(schemes=["bcrypt"], bcrypt__rounds=12), replacing AUTH-02's stdlib pbkdf2_hmac placeholder in place, with CryptContext.verify's typed UnknownHashError giving a clean, testable path for the documented placeholder-hash cutover.
